cases.why: Any caller can read any order: no ownership check and no authorisation anywhere in the project.

finding.message: Route handler 'get_order' uses parameter 'order_id' in a ORM lookup without checking the authenticated user.

> 14 | def get_order(order_id):

cases.why: The route is mounted behind requireAuth and ownerOnly, which compares the logged-in user with the row owner. The scanner only looked at the handler.
